title: Isolate native_board remote-url cache from SUSI_HOME and keep fast-release under 10s
goal: Anchor workspace susi.board.remote-url blob caches inside the repository git-common-dir instead of process-wide SUSI_HOME, self-heal wiped board-cache bare directories, keep secrets_vault env cleanup scoped to tempdir, filter multi-second subprocess/lock/KDF/IPC soak suites across the expanded pillar verification crates, and back fast-release test sandboxes with Linux tmpfs (/dev/shm) + TMPDIR + RUST_TEST_THREADS=12 so warm fast-release stays under 10s.

reuse.source: Existing native_board blob cache, susi_paths::tempfile, and SOAK_SKIP_FILTERS / HARNESS_SOAK_SKIP_FILTERS.
reuse.reason: Anchor workspace remote-url cache in git-common-dir, back ephemeral test sandboxes with Linux tmpfs (/dev/shm) and RAII cleanup, run binaries at RUST_TEST_THREADS=12, and skip multi-second soak suites in warm fast-release.

limitations: Filtered multi-second subprocess, file-lock, KDF, and plane-bus IPC soak suites remain recorded in verification.skipped_soak_tests and covered by cargo test --workspace and fast-release --full-soak.
